 Senator Susan Collins is hitting back against new claims from democrats saying she hasn’t done enough to push for winter heating relief, forcefully defending her record.
 Also read: Maine representatives call on Congress for more LIHEAP money 
 In a statement, a spokesperson for Senator Collins declared, “Collins has always been a champion of the LIHEAP program she increased its funding last year in the appropriations process and called for and secured the early release of this funding last week.”
 Her office also says she and Senator Angus King have called for the release of oil from the northeast reserve, promising the committee will consider increasing funding again this year.
